# `prefer-optional-presence-test`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: fix all · Options: none

Reports an optional capture used only to test whether the optional is present.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Comparing with `null` expresses a presence test without introducing an unused
payload binding.

## When it fires

It applies when the capture has no semantic use in the branch.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn present(maybe: ?u32) bool {
    return if (maybe) |_| true else false;
}
```
